title: 第1497章 为高权重者说话有分量第1496章 夸父再次发疯
slug: 西游反正很无聊随便打个劫呗
lines: 关于最后一只金乌的事情，后羿也是调查过的。
对方自称是在周天世界行走的陆压道人。
如果夸父见到陆压的话，可以想象双方绝对会打起来的。
现在夸父被后土娘娘又关回了地府，这其实是一个好消息。
“后土娘娘，除非必要的话，还是不要放夸父出来了。”
“这个家伙已经无法控制自己的心智了！”
“他离开地府只会捣乱！”
一旁的后土点了点头。
“看来现在还不是他呼吸新鲜空气的时候！”
“好了，不要管他了！”
“我们有着更重要的事情去做。”
三人的身形瞬间消失。
下一刻，出现在一片山谷内。
“后土娘娘，这里非常合适建立神庙。”
山谷中有一条河流流出。
整个山谷物资丰富，最重要的原因是这里的人迹罕至。
后土点了点头。
然后施展无上神力，一座巨大的宫殿凭空的出现在山谷内。
随后后土一挥手，那仅存的巫族百姓瞬间出现。
“终于又呼吸到了新鲜空气！”
一位老者激动地说道。
由于长时间生存在地府中，很多巫族百姓的皮肤变得异常的惨白。
有的人甚至开始亲吻大地。
还有的人已经爬上了附近的一棵大树。
后土悬浮在半空中。
“从今天开始，巫族复出！”
属于圣人的声音传遍整个周天世界。
此时正在欣赏歌舞的玉皇大帝放下了酒杯。
抬起右手示意歌舞暂停。
“太白，这件事情你怎么看？”
太白金星长出了一口气。
最近几十年可以说是多事之秋。
什么离谱的事情都发生过了。
妖帝复活，白界出现，圣人解除禁令，地道升华。
哪一件都足够影响整个三界。
相比之下，巫族复出就有些微不足道了。
“现在的巫族人口也不过数百万，而且还是在天竺国，对陛下的影响，可以说是微乎其微。”
本来天竺国就不是在玉皇大帝的统治范围之内。
content_en:
Hou Yi also investigated the matter about the last Golden Crow.
The other party claimed to be Taoist Lu Ya who walked in the Zhoutian world.
If Kuafu saw Lu Ya, it is conceivable that the two sides would definitely fight.
Now Kuafu has been imprisoned back to the underworld by Empress Houtu. This is actually good news.
"Mother Houtu, please don't let Kuafu out unless necessary."
"This guy can't control his mind anymore!"
"He will only cause trouble when he leaves the underworld!"
Houtu on the side nodded.
"Looks like it's not time for him to get some fresh air!"
"Okay, leave him alone!"
"We have more important things to do."
The figures of the three people disappeared instantly.
The next moment, he appeared in a valley.
"Empress Houtu, this is a very suitable place to build a temple."
A river flows out of the valley.
The entire valley is rich in resources, and the most important reason is that it is inaccessible.
"Yeah!"
Houtu nodded.
Then he exerted his supreme divine power, and a huge palace appeared out of thin air in the valley.
Then Hou Tu waved his hand, and the remaining Wu clan people appeared instantly.
“Finally a breath of fresh air again!”
An old man said excitedly.
Due to living in the underworld for a long time, the skin of many Wu people has become extremely pale.
Some even started kissing the ground.
Others had climbed up a nearby tree.
Houtu is suspended in mid-air.
"Starting today, the Witch Clan is back!"
The voice of the saint spread throughout the entire world.
At this time, the Jade Emperor, who was enjoying the singing and dancing, put down his wine glass.
Raise your right hand to signal a pause in singing and dancing.
"Taibai, what do you think about this matter?"
Taibai Jinxing let out a sigh of relief.
The past few decades have been eventful.
Outrageous things have happened.
The demon emperor is resurrected, the white world appears, the saint lifts the ban, and the earth sublimates.
Any one of them is enough to affect the entire Three Realms.
In comparison, the Wu Clan's comeback is somewhat insignificant.
"The current population of the Wu Clan is only a few million, and it is still in the country of Tianzhu. The impact on Your Majesty can be said to be minimal."
Originally, the Kingdom of Tianzhu was not within the jurisdiction of the Jade Emperor.
